result.title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
result.comment: Codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/JunboShen/SAE-Audit
result.summary: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究临床试验结果预测：把 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上的冻结 SAE 转成临床概念词表，用历史试验拟合的稀疏探针挑出与结局相关的概念，以带方向和强度的自然语言证据在推理时优化黑盒 LLM 的答案，并附带概念级可核查解释。
AI.relevance_reason: 「SAE 内部特征→稀疏探针筛证据→推理时注入」这条流程可能与 LVR 中 latent 内容鉴别、视觉证据筛选与贡献分配有方法类比，可供核查其探针选择与证据可靠性；但原文限于文本临床预测，无多模态推理状态，迁移属推测。
